the polymorphisms of APOB, APOE and ACE are not associated with hypertension and variations of lipids in Afro‐Brazilian subjects, except for the association of the APOB EcoR1 polymorphism with LDL‐C levels.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we have found a high prevalence of cardiovascular risk factors in Afro‐Brazilians.

ACE polymorphisms are associated with hypertension, but not with variations in serum lipids, in Afro‐Brazilians, while APOB polymorphisms are not associated with hypertension but are associated with LDL‐cholesterol variation.
